sulu_qr_code.file_usage_svg: Print: scales without quality loss, the file to send to a printer or a designer
sulu_qr_code.title: Label
sulu_qr_code.title_info: Internal name used to find this QR code. It never appears in the image.
sulu_qr_code.link_info: Can be changed at any time: QR codes that are already printed will follow the new destination.
sulu_qr_code.follow_visitor_locale_label: Follow the language of the visitor's phone
sulu_qr_code.follow_visitor_locale_info: If the destination exists in the visitor's language, they are redirected to it; otherwise they land on the language chosen above.
sulu_qr_code.foreground_color_info: Empty = black. Prefer a dark colour: contrast is what makes the code readable.
sulu_qr_code.background_color_info: Empty = white. It must clearly contrast with the QR code colour.
sulu_qr_code.size_info: Width of the PNG image, margin included. Empty = 1000. The SVG is vector-based and scales without loss.
sulu_qr_code.margin_info: Empty area around the code. Empty = 40. Too small a margin makes scanning harder.
sulu_qr_code.error_correction_level_info: The higher it is, the better the code withstands dirt, but the denser it gets. Always maximal with a logo.
sulu_qr_code.logo_info: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB. Always test the QR code before printing.
sulu_qr_code.logo_size_info: As a percentage of the code width, from 10 to 30. Empty = 20.
sulu_qr_code.public_url: Address encoded in the QR code
sulu_qr_code.public_url_info: This address never changes. The preview below is deliberately plain: the styled version is available in the "Downloads" tab.
sulu_qr_code.current_target_info: Where a scan leads right now, according to the last saved version.
sulu_qr_code.error.link_required: Choose the destination page of the QR code.
sulu_qr_code.error.invalid_external_url: The external address must start with http://, https://, mailto: or tel:.
sulu_qr_code.error.invalid_link: The link contains forbidden characters (spaces, line breaks) or is too long.
sulu_qr_code.error.invalid_color: Invalid colour: use the hexadecimal format, for example #1a2b3c.
sulu_qr_code.error.low_contrast: The contrast between the QR code and its background is too low to be scanned reliably.
sulu_qr_code.error.size_out_of_range: The size must be between {min} and {max} pixels.
sulu_qr_code.error.margin_out_of_range: The margin must be between {min} and {max} pixels (a quarter of the size at most).
sulu_qr_code.error.logo_size_out_of_rang: The logo size must be between {min} and {max}%.
sulu_qr_code.error.unsupported_logo: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most {maxSize} MB (SVG is not supported).
sulu_qr_code.error.logo_not_accessible: You are not allowed to use this media as a logo.
